captions.text: The kindest thing anyone ever told you about your
writing is that nobody wants to read it.
Once you believe that, you start writing things people
just cannot put down.
I mean, it really is the ultimate ego death
for a creator. But if you can actually internalize
it, it becomes well, it's the ultimate liberation.
Yeah, I have been thinking about that exact quote
for basically a week now.
We are unpacking Steven Pressfield's incredibly blunt,
just incredibly brilliant book, Nobody Wants to Read Your
Crap. And the specific lens we are looking through
today is going to permanently change how you look
at a blank page because we're setting up a
very specific almost uncomfortable dynamic
right out of the gate here.
